verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance documents its own registered-agent service: service-of-process receipt with phone notification, state forms pre-filled with its agent address, help switching from an existing provider, and a 'national registered agent' offering at $99/year. That points to multi-state coverage, but no cited item explicitly states the agent service is available in every US state. The 'all states' claim in docs-17 is about annual-report filing, not agent appointment, so it does not transfer. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement of 50-state registered-agent coverage, a state coverage list or map for agent service, and independent corroboration of nationwide availability.
